parts.html: The K-20 kitchen is a modern U-shaped kitchen with solid beige laminated chipboard fronts. The work zone, storage, and built-in appliances are all part of one unit.

The furniture runs along three sides: 5.1 linear meters of work surfaces and cabinets, with all the cooking zones close together. There is no island, so the center of the kitchen is clear to walk through.
Beige fronts go with light walls, wood, ceramic tile, or stone-effect surfaces, in a separate kitchen and in a kitchen-living room alike.

The standard configuration includes cabinet handles, Muller hinges without soft-close, and telescopic slides without soft-close. The kitchen is designed for built-in appliances. This model has no lift-up mechanisms or cargo pull-out.
We will change the side lengths of the K-20 and the placement of the cabinets, work surface, and built-in appliances to suit your kitchen.
